items.title: Julia Jacklin On Chaos, Control, And The Gem
items.summary: Julia Jacklin is changing her mind. There’s power in that. When I spoke with the Melbourne-based musician about her last album Pre Pleasure , in 2022, she imagined that her future self might approach music with more calculation. “Maybe when I have a bit more time, I’ll come in with real intentions. But at the moment, whatever happens is what the record is,” she told me . When we reconnect over a quick Zoom chat during release week for its follow-up, The Gem , Jacklin feels differently. items.title: Those Were the Days of Miracle and Wonder :: Paul Simon’s Graceland at 40
items.summary: Paul Simon’s 1986 album Graceland exists in this weird state, an album that eternally evokes 1986, but always sounds so different from other albums of its era. It’s an collection that’s self absorbed, but also so relatable when the listener finds themselves hitting middle age. It brought world music to the forefront, but also presented a misleading picture. It’s a fascinating study in contrast and now, some 40 years later it’s an album we still can’t make up our minds about even as we listen to it for the hundredth time.
